name: Experimental Lab // Staff Room
oracle_text:
When you unlock this door, manifest dread, then put two +1/+1 counters and a trample counter on that creature.
(You may cast either half. That door unlocks on the battlefield. As a sorcery, you may pay the mana cost of a locked door to unlock it.)
Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, turn that creature face up or put a +1/+1 counter on it.
(You may cast either half. That door unlocks on the battlefield. As a sorcery, you may pay the mana cost of a locked door to unlock it.)

needs.what: Room split permanents (rule 709.5): one card with two doors (Experimental Lab {3}{G}, Staff Room {2}{G}), castable as either half; the cast door enters unlocked and the other locked; a locked door's abilities are inactive; a sorcery-speed special action pays a locked door's mana cost to unlock it; name and mana value read only unlocked doors
needs.why_existing_wont_do: card_level_face_keys offers second_face/back_face, where the cast half becomes the whole object; nothing keeps both doors on one permanent with per-door locked/unlocked state, and no special action unlocks a door. Staff Room's static trigger must only work while that door is unlocked

needs.what: a trigger event 'when you unlock this door' firing when this door becomes unlocked, both when the door is cast (enters unlocked) and when unlocked later by the special action
needs.why_existing_wont_do: self_enters misses a later unlock and fires even when this door enters locked; trigger_events has no unlock event

needs.what: manifest dread (701.62): look at the top two cards of your library, manifest one of them, put the other into your graveyard; then refer to the manifested creature as 'that creature' so following effects can put two +1/+1 counters and a trample counter on it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: manifest takes only amount/cloak/player: no look-at-two-choose-one with the other milled, and no way to reference the manifested object afterwards; no trample keyword counter kind appears in the reference

needs.what: an effect op that turns a face-down permanent (the triggering creature) face up, offered as a choose_mode alternative to putting a +1/+1 counter on it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: turning face up exists only as the special action for face-down permanents; ops has no effect that turns a referenced creature face up
